newsitem.title: INDIA: India landslide kills at least 11 - news agency.
newsitem.headline: India landslide kills at least 11 - news agency.

text.p: Landslides triggered by heavy rain killed at least 11 people on Wednesday in the Darjeeling hills in eastern India, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency quoted local officials as saying the death toll was expected to rise.
Rescuers had recovered eight bodies but operations were hampered by heavy rain, PTI said.
